messages:
incident-bot: Pager — metering-alert: token-count divergence detected for prod-us-east ingest pipeline. Spike in emitter latency + delayed emits. Severity: P2. Runbook: <https://rwd.internal/runbooks/metering-delay>

sre_oncall: Ack. Investigating. @devin you're on-call for billing today — can you pick this up?

devin: on it. Pulling latest emitter offsets, kafka consumer lags, and aggregator diffs.

billing-eng: I'm here. Any customer-visible flags yet?

sre_oncall: Alerting rules show ~12% token delta across eu1->us-east windowed counts, started ~00:10 UTC. No billing charges sent yet but overage-flagging protos fired for 3 accounts.

alex: I see consumer group ingest-consumer-3 with lag ~45k on partition p-17. Looks like a consumer restart around 00:09. /cc @marta

marta: I restarted that consumer at 00:09 due to OOM and it came back up, but logs show sustained backpressure after restart. Paste last lines: 
```
WARN emitter: backpressure applied, buffer=62450
INFO consumer: commit failed: org.apache.kafka.common.errors.TimeoutException: Failed to commit offsets in time
```

devin: ok — if the consumer fell behind we probably have a backlog causing delayed emits. Starting a targeted replay for 00:08-00:12 on p-17. If replay doesn't reduce delta in 5m we'll escalate.

sre_oncall: Start replay and throttle ingestion to avoid duplicate counts. Safety: disable outbound billing emails for flagged accounts until reconcile. Commands to run: 
```
./admin replay --topic metering-events --partition 17 --from 00:08:00 --to 00:12:00
curl -XPOST https://api.internal/ingest/throttle -d '{"rate":0.5}'
```

billing-eng: Recon note: reconciler is idempotent for replayed messages if epk header present. If epk missing we might double-count — check headers on replay.

devin: replay job started (job id r-6980012345-1). Watching aggregator diff and dedupe header counts.

sre_oncall: Also create a short suppress on billing-notify for the three accounts flagged: acct_42, acct_137, acct_9001.

alex: Disabled billing-notify for those accounts via admin console :white_check_mark:.

marta: Replay initially failing with upstream 503s from ingest proxy, trying a retry. Error snippet: 
```
ERROR 503 proxy: upstream overloaded
```

devin: switched proxy route to eu-ingest-backup and retried; job progressed to 40% then 80%. Aggregator diff down to +6% and trending down.

billing-eng: I'm pushing a small reconciler patch to treat missing epk as 'retry later' instead of hard-flag; will deploy to prod after quick smoke.

sre_oncall: Good. If delta > 5% at t+20m we prep customer comms. Current impact estimate: delayed usage reports and transient overage flags for a handful of accounts, no customer charges pushed yet.

incident-bot: Update — replay r-6980012345-1 at 80% complete (00:16 UTC). Next update in 5m.

devin: replay job r-6980012345-1 completed at 00:18 UTC. Aggregator diff down to +0.8%. Kicking full reconcile pass now.

billing-eng: Recon completed and corrections applied to shadow ledger. Overflag state auto-cleared for the 3 accounts. Billing emails remain suppressed. We'll keep elevated monitoring for 2 hours.

sre_oncall: Wrapping up here — follow-ups: add auto-retry to replay controller for proxy 503s, alert on consumer OOM restarts tying to lag spikes, and make reconciler more tolerant of missing epk headers (infra#2345). Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation complete). Postmortem: infra/incident-6980012345 to be filed.
